statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-46675 (GHSA-qvg3-h654-xq3j) is a use-after-free of zlib input in png_read_end after an incomplete zTXt, iTXt or iCCP decompression: the zstream kept pointers into an input buffer that may since have been freed. Upstream fixed it on the 1.6 branch in libpng 1.6.59 with commit aa77ef38c17ab2fc1b41bec09fb973c6a386641d, which adds png_inflate_detach_buffers to pngrutil.c and calls it wherever the stream is claimed or released (commit 6c7783b151377f591c83955e23da50991ad1a600 is the same fix for the 1.8 branch). Debian backported the 1.6 commit, with all five call sites, to trixie in 1.6.48-1+deb13u6 (DSA-6537-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-46675). The DHI Debian repository publishes one build of the libpng1.6 source, a rebuild of Debian 1.6.48-1+deb13u6, for amd64 and arm64, and it carries the fix: the debug symbols for the shipped libpng16.so.16.48.0 on each architecture (matched by build ID) name png_inflate_detach_buffers. Earlier libpng1.6 builds, based on Debian 1.6.48-1+deb13u5 or older, predate the fix, are no longer published, and sort below this version.
